mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_schedule (doctor_id, department_id, visit_date, period, slot_type, fee_cents, total_slots, release_at, visit_start, visit_end, status) VALUES (#{doctorId}, (SELECT department_id FROM t_doctor WHERE id=#{doctorId}), #{visitDate}, #{period}, #{slotType}, #{feeCents}, #{totalSlots}, NOW(), #{visitStart}, #{visitEnd}, 'PENDING')
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) AS count FROM t_appointment WHERE schedule_id=#{scheduleId} GROUP BY status
SELECT id, name, phone, no_show_count AS noShowCount, blocked_until AS blockedUntil FROM t_patient WHERE blocked_until IS NOT NULL AND blocked_until > NOW() ORDER BY blocked_until DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE t_patient SET blocked_until=NULL, no_show_count=0 WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT total_slots AS totalSlots, released_slots AS releasedSlots, status FROM t_schedule WHERE id=#{scheduleId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_schedule SET status='OPEN' WHERE id=#{scheduleId}
UPDATE t_schedule SET status='CLOSED' WHERE id=#{scheduleId}
UPDATE t_schedule SET released_slots = released_slots + #{amount} WHERE id = #{scheduleId} AND released_slots + #{amount} <= total_slots
UPDATE t_schedule SET released_slots = GREATEST(0, released_slots - #{n}) WHERE id = #{scheduleId}
